speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-year-old having trouble sleeping due to waking up frightened; can you describe exactly what happens when these episodes occur and if anyone else is involved?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Night Terror.

Thank you for the details; the fact that she wakes frightened but is consolable and returns to normal behavior the next day strongly suggests a parasomnia rather than a nightmare. Since these episodes occur once or twice a week and are affecting her daytime energy, do you have any family history of sleep disturbances or nightmares?
